desc:
🌴☀️Take a vacation or perform your dream vacation job in this amazing tropical island resort roleplay!⛱️🐬

✨Join our group to gain X2 experience points & to hang out with the resort community✨:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/4626344

Splash in the resort pools, play soccer, watch performances on the stage, go trampolining, eat at the worldwide buffet and so much more! 🥘 🎭

Job roles:
👨‍🍳Chef
⛑️Lifeguard
🔖Receptionist
🛡️Security
🧹Housekeeper

The resort has 16 Standard rooms and 4 Premium villas.

🔔 Press the 'Follow' button for game news & updates! 🔔

Developers: RPD777 and RJD12345
